title: A view of the bulk from the worldline
abstract: Develops worldline quantum mechanics as a framework for understanding gravity-coupled particle dynamics in AdS/CFT. Derives the AdS heat kernel from worldline quantum mechanics, computes four-point functions and conformal blocks from worldline path integrals. Establishes gauge-fixed worldline path integrals, perturbation theory, vertex operators, and connects to geodesic Witten diagrams. Directly bridges worldline formalism to bulk geometry and boundary CFT correlators.
key_claims: AdS heat kernel derived from worldline quantum mechanics
Four-point functions computed from worldline path integrals in AdS
Gauge-fixed worldline path integrals with vertex operators map to conformal blocks
Geodesic Witten diagrams emerge from worldline perturbation theory
Worldline formalism provides efficient computation of bulk-boundary correlators
